findings: ETT.tex:2346–2350 (rem:CBG_manquant (i)): the remark says the second countability of the limit is unchecked and « should follow Geroch's argument ». Read in DEC-25, it holds at every Hausdorff, connected E≥0-manifold with a second countable Cauchy surface, with no global hyperbolicity and no Geroch argument on the singular part: Reg(M) is second countable by the flat theorem (DEC-49, already the developing-map form of Geroch). Each component of Sing(M) is a line meeting the Cauchy surface exactly once, and is open in Sing(M). So Sing(M) ∩ S is discrete, hence countable, and M is Lindelöf (secondCountableTopology_of_isCauchySurface). For the limit, S is the image of Σ₀. Hausdorffness is used, so this comes after the Hausdorff property, not before. The author may want to replace the remark's (i) by this argument once the E₀ instance exists. Not a defect of a stated result.
questions: No new reading. « Second countable Cauchy surface » is read as SecondCountableTopology of S with the subspace topology of M, which is the field's own hypothesis (Causal/CBG/Geometry.lean:342). The field's structure s : Str M is read as the DEC-25 structure together with any C having IsoChartsCoverDEC25 over massAModelCausality, as in the earlier A2 rows. theo:CBG is named as the consumer only (the E₀ instance of its geometry, T-ett-cbg-e0); no assertion of theo:CBG is proved here. Readings carried, not chosen here: DEC-25 and OQ-18 (manifolds and causalities), DEC-14 (Cauchy surface), OQ-34/OQ-35 (E₀) and OQ-82 (the group) in the witnesses.

kb_proposals: Second countability of an E≥0-manifold from a second countable Cauchy surface: Causal.SingularRowsSecondCountable.secondCountableTopology_of_isCauchySurface needs only [T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M], IsoChartsCoverDEC25 and S Cauchy with SecondCountableTopology S. It uses no global hyperbolicity and no absolute minimality. secondCountable_of_cauchy is A2's field verbatim, and _of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25 is its natural-causality form. It turns a Cauchy surface's countability into M's, so the A2 fields that take [SecondCountableTopology M] apply (T-ett-sc-cauchy-e0).

Reg(M) of every connected, Hausdorff singular (Isom 𝐌³, 𝐌³)-manifold is second countable, with no chart cover: secondCountableTopology_reg. The recipe: put opensSingularGXStructure on U = ⟨Reg M, isOpen_reg⟩, whose own Reg is univ by reg_opensSingular. Then chartedSpaceOfAtlas and hasGroupoid_chartedSpaceOfAtlas with (isMaximalAEAtlas_aeAtlas _ _ U).1.1, IsPortly.isConnected, and Flat.flat_secondCountableTopology (d := 2) (T-ett-sc-cauchy-e0).

Each component of sing_α(M) is open in Sing(M) (exists_isOpen_inter_sing_subset, from IsLineDevelopment.local_onto at t = 0) and meets every Cauchy surface exactly once (existsUnique_mem_component_inter). So Sing(M) ∩ S is a discrete subspace of S. Its countability is discreteTopology_iff_isOpen_singleton followed by separableSpace_iff_countable (T-ett-sc-cauchy-e0).
